verdict.rationale: Wave's own docs say it generates the profit & loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow report automatically, built on double-entry accounting, with month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons. The evidence does not show reports for any arbitrary custom period on demand, which is why this is partial rather than full. Accuracy rests only on vendor claims, and the Pro page placement suggests these reports may be tier-gated. Missing for 10: documented custom/arbitrary date-range selection for all three statements, independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy, and clarity on which plan includes the statements.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Generate your profit & loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow report automatically—no spreadsheets required.
show month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons so you can easily identify cash flow trends
Wave uses real, double-entry accounting software.
